quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: And I found out that when I really got down to putting out do’s and don’ts, and lots of these included take torture for this and that, and this and that, and never take any amnesty, for reasons they all understood and went along with.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: And in many cases, they’re illegally here, illegal immigrants.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: They’ve never endorsed anybody before on immigration.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: I was just recently endorsed—16,500 Border Patrol agents.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: And perhaps they passed the wrong button, they pressed the wrong button, or perhaps worse than that, it was corruption, but these people that we were going to deport for good reason ended up becoming citizens.

quotes.speaker: WELKER
quotes.quote: WELKER: We are going to move on to immigration — TRUMP: One thing very quickly.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: We’re going to talk about immigration, now, gentlemen, and we’re going to talk about families within this context.

quotes.speaker: WELKER
quotes.quote: WELKER: Let me ask about your immigration policy, Mr.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: The Obama administration did fail to deliver immigration reform, which had been a key promise during the administration.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: It also presided over record deportations as well as family detentions at the border before changing course.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: So why should voters trust you with an immigration overhaul now?

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: And the fact is, I’ve made it very clear, within 100 days, I’m going to send to the United States Congress a pathway to citizenship for over 11 million undocumented people.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: And all those so called Dreamers, those DACA kids, they’re going to be immediately certified again, to be able to stay in this country, and put on a path to citizenship.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: This is the first President in the history of the United States of America that anybody seeking asylum has to do it in another country.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: That I seek asylum based on the following premise, why I deserve it under American law.

quotes.speaker: CANDIDATE
quotes.quote: It just shows that he has no understanding of immigration or the laws.

quotes.speaker: TRUMP
quotes.quote: TRUMP: We have to send ICE out and Border Patrol out to find them.
